visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with glasses and a pink t-shirt speaks directly to the camera in a kitchen setting. He gestures toward a pot on the stove where several eggs are boiling in white, frothy water. The lighting is bright and even. (2) The man shows a large clear plastic container filled with dozens of brown and white eggs. He appears to be preparing to cook them. (3) He carefully places individual eggs into a pot of boiling water. The kitchen background is clean with white cabinets and modern appliances. (4) Close-up of the pot as the water boils over; many eggs have cracked, and white strands of cooked egg white float on the surface. (5) The man, looking somewhat disappointed, holds a cracked egg and then sits with a young girl. They are peeling the hard-boiled eggs into a large metal bowl. A woman is seen briefly in the background. (6) The man and the girl are now at a kitchen counter. They are cutting large blocks of white tofu and brown bean curd into smaller pieces. (7) They place the cut tofu into a large stainless steel pot. The girl helps by handing him pieces or stirring. (8) The girl adds red spoonfuls of salt and a handful of peppercorns into a pot of clear liquid. (9) The man prepares another dish, showing a tray of raw pork liver. (13) The man sits at a table, eating the finished pork liver dish and drinking a glass of beer with ice. He speaks enthusiastically to the camera, showcasing the food. (14) Final shot of a large pot of tea eggs in a dark broth, followed by the man taking a big gulp of beer and a cute cartoon illustration of a boy and girl.
